svg.title: TYPE_CHARGE_AGV -> PlanAgvChargeJob()
svg.desc: Send AGV A to the cheapest free charger. A is trapped in bay B21 (insert mode), so the bay is switched to retrieve mode to let it out and switched back afterwards.
